I'll be looking at some results from a study on cluster headaches from clinicaltrials.gov!

[Link to dataset](https://clinicaltrials.gov/data-api/api)

Things you plan to investigate using this dataset:

- Extract study information
- Extract the results and measurements
- Make some visualizations (charts, graphs, perhaps more...)

Stat 351 topics you plan to cover during the analysis:

1. Topic 1

-   Scraping an API without authentication

2. Topic 2

-   Parsing JSON, turning it into tabular format

3. Topic 3

-   Functional Programming, with purrr

4. Topic 4

-   Creating good graphics

5. Topic 5 

-   Shiny App
